description: This file defines the CartScreen widget for a Flutter mobile app, managing the shopping cart UI, including displaying cart items, clearing the cart, and placing an order via providers.

classes.name: CartScreen
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays shopping cart items, allows clearing the cart, and placing orders.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the cart screen, rendering cart items, and placing order functionality.

methods.name: placeOrder
methods.description: Asynchronous function that calls the order provider to place the order and updates UI based on success or failure.
